ping.short_description: Check the bot's latency and responsiveness
ping.description: Check the bot's current latency (response time) to Discord. This command helps you verify that the bot is responsive and shows the network delay in milliseconds. Useful for diagnosing connection or performance issues.
notes: Shows latency in milliseconds (ms)
Lower latency means faster bot response
Useful for checking if the bot is responsive
No parameters required

play.short_description: Play a song or playlist from Spotify/YouTube with search or URL
play.description: Search for and play music by providing a song title, artist name, URL, or playlist link. The bot will automatically join your voice channel and start playing. Supports YouTube links, Spotify links, and search queries. Uses autocomplete to suggest songs as you type.
notes: You must be in a voice channel to use this command
The bot will automatically join your voice channel when you play a song
Supports Spotify links, YouTube links, and search queries
Autocomplete will suggest songs as you type (requires 2+ characters)
If you add a playlist, it will be queued and the first song will play
Maximum queue size limit applies - songs beyond the limit will be skipped

playlist create.short_description: Create a new playlist to save your favorite songs
playlist create.description: Create a new playlist where you can save and organize your favorite songs. You can optionally add a description to your playlist. Playlist names are limited to 30 characters. Once created, you can add songs to it and view them anytime.
examples: /playlist create Chill Vibes Best relaxing songs for studying
notes: Playlist name must be 30 characters or less
Description is optional
Playlist is private to your account
You can create multiple playlists
Use /playlist show to see all your playlists
Each playlist gets a unique 16-character ID

playlist show.short_description: View all your playlists with song counts
playlist show.description: Display a list of all your created playlists with song counts. Shows your playlist names, descriptions (if any), when they were created, and how many songs each contains. The list is paginated for easy browsing.
notes: Shows all playlists you have created
Displays song count for each playlist
Shows creation date for each playlist
Results are paginated (10 playlists per page)
Shows playlist descriptions if available
Use /playlist view <name> to see the songs in a playlist

playlist view.short_description: View all songs in a specific playlist with add buttons
playlist view.description: Display all songs in a specific playlist with song titles, artists, and cover artwork. Each song has an 'Add' button that allows you to queue it to the current playback. Songs are displayed in pages of 5 for easy browsing. Perfect for reviewing your saved songs before playing them.
notes: You must specify an existing playlist name
Uses autocomplete to help you find playlist names
Displays songs in pages of 5
Each song has an 'Add' button to queue it
Shows song title, artist, and artwork
Must be in a voice channel to use the 'Add' buttons
Songs are displayed in order they were added

playlist add.short_description: Add a song or playlist to one of your playlists
playlist add.description: Search for and add songs to your playlists. You can add individual songs or entire playlists. The command uses autocomplete to suggest songs/playlists as you type. You'll be shown a dropdown to select which playlist to add the song(s) to. Supports URLs and search queries.
notes: Song name or URL is required
Autocomplete suggests songs as you type
Can add individual songs or entire playlists
You'll select the target playlist from a dropdown
Maximum 250 songs per playlist
Supports Spotify links, YouTube links, and search queries
Batch processing adds up to 100 songs at once for playlists
Shows success/error messages after adding

playlist delete.description: Permanently delete a playlist and all its songs. Once deleted, the playlist cannot be recovered. Use this when you want to remove a playlist you no longer need. Uses autocomplete to help you select the correct playlist.
notes: Deletion is permanent - cannot be undone
All songs in the playlist will be deleted
Uses autocomplete to find playlist names
Only you can delete your own playlists
Confirm the playlist name before deleting
Shows confirmation when deleted successfully

playlist manage.short_description: Manage songs in a playlist - remove specific tracks
playlist manage.description: View and manage the songs in a specific playlist. This command displays all songs with individual 'Delete' buttons so you can remove specific tracks from your playlist. Perfect for cleaning up your playlists or removing songs you no longer want. Songs are displayed in pages of 5.
notes: You must specify an existing playlist name
Uses autocomplete to help you find playlist names
Displays songs in pages of 5
Each song has a 'Delete' button to remove it
Shows song title, artist, and artwork
Only you can manage your own playlists
Songs are displayed in order they were added
Deleted songs are removed immediately from the playlist

connect.short_description: Manually connect the bot to your voice channel
connect.description: Manually connect the bot to the voice channel you are currently in. Usually the bot connects automatically when you use /play, but you can use this command to reconnect manually if needed. The bot will join your channel and wait for commands.
notes: You must be in a voice channel to use this command
The bot automatically connects when you use /play
If the bot is already in your voice channel, it will show a confirmation
Useful for reconnecting if the bot accidentally leaves or if you join a different channel
The bot will remain in the voice channel until /disconnect or /stop is used

disconnect.short_description: Disconnect the bot and stop all playback
disconnect.description: Stop the currently playing song and disconnect the bot from the voice channel completely. This will clear the queue and remove the bot from the channel entirely. Unlike /stop, this command fully disconnects the bot.
notes: This will stop the music and disconnect the bot completely
The queue will be cleared when disconnecting
Use /stop if you want to stop music but keep the bot in the voice channel
Use /connect to reconnect the bot after using this command
All playback information will be reset

stop.short_description: Stop playback and clear the queue but stay connected
stop.description: Stop the currently playing song and clear the entire queue. The bot will remain in the voice channel and continue to stay connected. This is useful if you want to pause and clear everything but keep the bot ready for new commands.
notes: This will stop the music and clear the queue
The bot remains connected to the voice channel
Use /disconnect to fully disconnect the bot from voice
Use /play to start playing music again after stopping
The bot's volume and settings will be preserved

queue.short_description: Display all songs in the current queue
queue.description: Show all songs currently queued up, displayed in order. The currently playing song will be shown at the top. The queue is paginated, so you can view multiple pages if there are many songs. Displays essential info like song title, artist, and duration for each track.
notes: You must be in the same voice channel as the bot to use this command
The bot must be playing music or have songs in the queue
Displays the currently playing song at the top
Queue is displayed with song titles, artists, and duration
Useful for checking what's coming up next
Shows pagination info if queue is very long

reset.short_description: Reset the player and return to the original voice channel
reset.description: Reset the bot's player state completely, clear the queue, and return the bot to the original voice channel it connected to. Useful if you encounter connection issues, the bot gets stuck, or you want to completely refresh the player state. This is a full reset that clears all playback data.
notes: This will clear the queue and stop all playback
The bot returns to the original voice channel it joined
Player container is completely reset to initial state
Use this if you experience connection issues or the bot gets stuck
All playback settings and queue will be cleared
After reset, you can start playing music again with /play
